relevance_note: Case report of a young woman and her mother, "both of them carriers of a novel truncating variant in the LAMP2 gene".
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a short Python script in the scratch directory, with every span checked verbatim against the paper. No tables in the paper; no stacked cells. Two in-scope people: the single unnamed patient of the case report ('patient', rule 5) and her mother ('mother of patient', rule 2). The father ('Her father died at the age of 36 years due to an extracardiac cause') was neither tested nor described as affected, so he gets no row. Maron et al.'s 7 obligate carrier women [11] are described only at group level and get no rows. 'hypertrophic cardiomyopathy diagnosed at 12 years' is a diagnosis of the cardiomyopathy, not of Danon disease; it is recorded as onset of that feature, and age_at_diagnosis is left not reported. Figure 1 legend (atrial premature complexes, prolonged QT 503 ms) is used for the proband because the text ties her ECG to Figure 1. 'Atrioventricular valves were normal' is recorded as written (excluded 'abnormal atrioventricular valves') although mitral regurgitation is also reported; the authors attribute the MR to decreased LV function and high filling pressure, so it is not listed as a contradiction, but note the tension. 'normal PR interval' excludes only an abnormal PR interval; it does not exclude the composite checklist items for pre-excitation or AV block, which stay not reported. 'She had no intellectual impairment' and the group statement 'we have not found skeletal myopathy or mental retardation in our female carriers' (group = proband and mother) do not exclude the composite checklist item 'intellectual disability, cognitive impairment or learning difficulties' (learning difficulties not addressed); skeletal myopathy is excluded for both. 'complex ventricular arrhythmias' is not specific enough to mark ventricular tachycardia or fibrillation. Zygosity not reported: the paper speaks of heterozygous females only in general. Mother: 'without ... systolic dysfunction' does not address LV dilation, so the composite dilated/hypokinetic item stays not reported.
